title: Step 5 strategy route retained as compatibility pass-through redirect
description: frontend/app/(frame)/screener/step-5-strategy/page.tsx unconditionally redirects to /screener/step-4-stocks following the consolidation of strategy selection and execution parameters into Step 4. StepNavBar and direct route transitions pass through without error, but the segment remains a legacy architectural redirect.
remediation: Retained for backward URL compatibility across bookmarks and external references.

title: mean_reversion_vwap intraday bar requirement inside multi-strategy engine
description: backend/app/services/strategy_engine.py:1420-1421 explicitly raises ValueError if mean_reversion_vwap is included in mean_reversion_multi variants on daily bars. Mean reversion multi uses mean_reversion_vwap_daily_signal for rolling daily VWAP instead. Frontend UI disables mean_reversion_vwap in multi variant selection to prevent runtime ValueError.
remediation: Documented engine constraint and variant validation contract.
